notes.title: The Online Challenges Update - v2.28.0
notes.content:
Dear Blowers,

Version 2.28.0 is here! This update introduces Daily and Weekly Challenges, a new way to test your skills, earn rewards, and compete with others. I've also included a number of QoL improvements, some shop updates, and several bug fixes that should smooth things out across the board.

Here's what's new:

[h2][b]🏆 Daily & Weekly Challenges[/b][/h2]

You can now take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges through your Humble North account.

• Go to [b]Account → Seasons & Challenges[/b] to get started.

• You can retry a challenge as many times as you like to set your best time.

• After the challenge ends (by the end of the day/week), rewards can be claimed via [b]Account → Claimable Rewards[/b].

• Higher ranks earn better rewards.

• Requires being logged in to your Humble North account.

Whether you're after a top leaderboard spot or just in it for some extra rewards, there's something in it for everyone.

[h2][b]🛒 New Additions to Shops[/b][/h2]

• [b]Crunchy Pyramids[/b] added to the ULC shop.

• [b]Speedstige[/b]: A new upgrade in the Gems shop that speeds up the prestige animation.

• [b]Fishing Spot Search Charges[/b]: New shop item that lets you search for fishing spots more efficiently.

• [b]Fish Credits → Advanced Tide Crystal[/b]: A new transmuter has been added.

[h2][b]🎣 Fishing Updates[/b][/h2]

• [b]Auto Win[/b] for fishing tournaments is now available in the Fishing shop (requires 10 tournament wins).

• A [b]cancel button[/b] has been added to fishing tournaments.

• [b]Fishing spot pity counter[/b] is now available (upgrade in the Fishing shop).

• [b]Fishing rod bonus[/b] now correctly applies to regular fishing spots.

• [b]Offline progress[/b] improvements: search timer and tournament end timeout now run offline.

• [b]Fishing spot search charges[/b] added (requires new shop item).

[h2][b]🛠️ Crafting & General QoL[/b][/h2]

• Auto salvage no longer requires auto crafting to be enabled.

• Changing salvage options now sets a 5-second timeout to prevent accidental salvaging.

• [b]Buy Max[/b] option added to shops.

• [b]BV Auto Craft Count[/b] upgrade added to the ULC shop.

• [b]Trades[/b] can now only be accepted if you've unlocked the reward resource.

• [b]Claim All[/b] button added for DLCs (especially useful for daily challenge rewards).

[h2][b]⚙️ Fixes & Misc[/b][/h2]

• Fixed an overflow issue with shop item max counts.

• Fixed a time travel bug in challenges.

• Potential fix for a fishing rod bug.

• New [b]"Drowned"[/b] stat added for community leaves. (This is a local counter tied to your save file - still fun to watch)

• [b]Safe Attack[/b] option added for Shadow Crystal.

• New skin: [b]Sacred Flokcette[/b].

• On Android, challenge save screens now show the correct gameplay time when syncing to Google Cloud.

Thanks for all the feedback and reports. This update includes many of the things folks have been asking for, and I’ll continue working on improvements and future content. As always, feel free to reach out with thoughts or bug reports.

notes.title: The Fishing Update - v2.27.0
notes.content:
[h1]Fishing - v2.27.0[/h1]

Dear Blowers,

I'm excited to announce that the new update is live! This update introduces Fishing, a fresh mechanic packed with engaging content, a new challenge, and lots of quality-of-life improvements.

Also, I'd like to thank the beta testers for your incredible dedication and invaluable feedback during the testing phase!

Here's whats new:

[h3]🎣 Fishing[/h3]
Craft and upgrade your fishing rods to catch 24 unique fish, each with specific rarities and special upgrade effects. Every catch adds XP to your Fishing Journey, granting valuable rewards such as fish, credits, and more as you level up.

[h3]🏆 Compete in Fishing Tournaments[/h3]
Participate in Fishing Tournaments to earn extra prizes and upgrade your specialized Tournament Rod for better results.

[h3]🌌 New Area and Boss: Spiral Walk (Umbral Cluster)[/h3]
Test your strength against a new late-game boss waiting in the Spiral Walk area.

[h3]🤖 More Autobuy Bots & Convenience Features[/h3]
Added autobuy bots for Sacred, Biotite, Malachite, Hematite, Plasma, Electrical Energy, Coal, Dusk, and MLC shops.
Auto Banks now allow automatic deposits after ULC, and BV packs have a new buy/open multiplier similar to Cards.

[h3]🌟 Improved Daily & Offline Rewards UI[/h3]
The offline and daily reward screens have received UI improvements, making them clearer and more user-friendly.

[h3]🐟 Fishing Pack[/h3]
If you'd like to give your fishing experience a boost, there's a new Fishing Pack available as IAP.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]

[*]Fishing Journey: Each catch also contributes XP toward your Journey level - earn prizes like fish, credits and more as you level up.

Thank you all once again for your continued support. Enjoy fishing, and as always, your feedback is greatly appreciated!

Happy fishing!

- Speedrun videos should be uploaded to Twitch or YouTube publicly in the following format: Leaf Blower Revolution Speedrun - 12:34 - 56789 frames - <video-link>
- Post your videos in #speedrun-submissions on our discord server.
- You may participate in all categories, but only your best time counts as a submission.
- Event closes on Sunday, May 9th, 23:59 CET

Happy speedrunning! Save the frames!

notes.title: You Can Blow Leaves Now
notes.content:
The leaf blowing season is almost over, but you can still enjoy this wonderful labor with Leaf Blower Revolution.

After countless cups of coffee, cups of tea, and cups of beer, I have finally released my first game on Steam. Kind of a milestone I'd say. The idea of developing this game came—yes, you're right—while mowing the lawn. Being a big fan of idle games myself, I couldn't resist creating an original one.

Opposing to many recent idle games where you feel like you're not playing the actual game but instead battle the devs to whether you can progress further into the game without throwing money into a sinkhole, I wanted to create a relaxing idle game that everyone can play for free. The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1468260/Leaf_Blower_Revolution__Idle_Game/]DLC packs [/url] are completely optional though you would support my work so I can continue working on the game to add more content.

A big "THANK YOU" goes towards the testers on the [url=https://discord.gg/tbBqfgwQWj]Discord channel[/url] who provided valuable feedback to improve the game.

Well, I'm off to blowing some leaves now.

Enjoy!
